'''2007 Ohio State Championship David McCune LS An Unusual Amount Of Fear''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2007 Ohio State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Pile of Cheese
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
